question_or_proposition: For Total Dissolved Solids at the Water Plants Intake (*7), does the permit establish enforceable numeric discharge limits or monitoring-and-reporting requirements only, and what monitoring frequency, sample type, and measurement and reporting method does footnote *7 require?
required_context: Water Plants Intake (*7) row showing Report in all limit columns and 1/Week measurement frequency with 12-Hour Composite sample type
Footnote *7: flow-weighted-average total dissolved solids measured at the intake of the two drinking water treatment plants, with reporting of the geometric mean of weekly values
Adjacent Total Dissolved Solids rows for Discharge (*6) and Net Increase (*8), including footnotes *6 and *8
PART I table column headers distinguishing limit types (30-day avg, daily max, 7-day avg) from measurement frequency and sample type
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, Page: 4, Section: part_i, Total Dissolved Solids, Water Plants Intake row
notes: Interpretation of the Report-only limit entries and footnote *7 could change whether intake TDS measurements are subject to numeric compliance comparison (Purpose A), what monitoring was required (Purpose B), and how absent intake TDS evidence is classified when no ordinary numeric limit applies (Purpose C).
